name: Wagu Mono
description: A crafted, warm store theme for furniture workshops that sell chairs, tables, benches, shelves and small wooden things online: oak-beige pages with a faint wood grain drawn only in CSS, walnut ink and an oak accent, Libre Caslon headings over Karla text; a walnut side rail fixed on the left with the wordmark, a numbered menu and a vertical spine line (a compact top bar with an accessible menu on phones), a home page of four chapters (Wood, Joint, Finish, Living with it) scrolling beside a sticky drawing plate that pairs a photograph with a joinery diagram and changes with the chapter, then the pieces as numbered cards; a footer set like a book's colophon that credits the makers, woods, joints, finish and typefaces; makers and care (oil, cleaning, repair service) pages, about, a journal, a newsletter and contact, the showroom details kept in one synced pattern so they are edited once, and WooCommerce shop, product, cart, checkout and account templates styled to match.

fonts.role: the page titles, the wordmark and the large chapter numerals

fonts.role: headings, the menu in the rail, prices, quotes and the italic second voice

fonts.role: body text, labels, buttons, tables and forms

store.withoutPlugin: The shop page shows every piece with its photograph, wood and price, and orders go by phone, email or in the showroom; store templates are not used.
